import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# -------------------------------
# 1. Load trip-level data
# -------------------------------
TRIP_PATH = "chunks_csv/cyclehire_w007.csv"
ADJ_PATH   = "chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv"

trips = pd.read_csv(TRIP_PATH)

# Keep only rows with non-missing borough names
mask = trips["StartBorough"].notna() & trips["EndBorough"].notna()
trips  = trips.loc[mask, ["StartBorough", "EndBorough"]]

# -------------------------------
# 2. Compute Self-Containment Ratio per borough
# -------------------------------
departures        = trips.groupby("StartBorough").size()                      # 1. Departures
self_contained    = trips[trips["StartBorough"] == trips["EndBorough"]] \
                        .groupby("StartBorough").size()                       # 2. Self-contained
ratio = (self_contained / departures).fillna(0.0).rename("SCR")               # 3. Ratio

# -------------------------------
# 3. Build undirected adjacency dictionary
# -------------------------------
adj_df = pd.read_csv(ADJ_PATH)

neighbors = {b:set() for b in pd.unique(adj_df[["borough","neighbor"]].values.ravel())}
for b, n in adj_df.itertuples(index=False):
    neighbors[b].add(n)
    neighbors[n].add(b)       # ensure symmetry

# Keep only boroughs that have a ratio AND at least one neighbour
candidate_boroughs = [b for b in ratio.index if len(neighbors.get(b,[]))>0]
ratio = ratio.loc[candidate_boroughs]
neighbors = {b: [n for n in nbrs if n in ratio.index]
             for b, nbrs in neighbors.items()
             if b in ratio.index and len([n for n in nbrs if n in ratio.index])>0}

# Re-filter ratio to make sure every borough remaining still has ≥1 neighbour
ratio = ratio.loc[neighbors.keys()]

boroughs  = ratio.index.tolist()
index_map = {b:i for i,b in enumerate(boroughs)}
values    = ratio.values
N         = len(values)

# -------------------------------
# 4. Function to compute Moran's I
# -------------------------------
def morans_I(vals):
    z = vals - vals.mean()
    denom = np.dot(z, z)
    num   = 0.0
    for i, b in enumerate(boroughs):
        k = len(neighbors[b])
        w = 1.0 / k
        zi = z[i]
        for nb in neighbors[b]:
            j  = index_map[nb]
            num += w * zi * z[j]
    # row-standardised weights → ΣΣ w_ij  = N
    S0 = N
    return (N / S0) * (num / denom)

# -------------------------------
# 5. Observed Moran's I
# -------------------------------
I_obs = morans_I(values)

# -------------------------------
# 6. Permutation test (999 permutations)
# -------------------------------
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)   # reproducible
permutations = 999
I_perm = np.empty(permutations)

for p in range(permutations):
    I_perm[p] = morans_I(rng.permutation(values))

p_value = np.mean(np.abs(I_perm) >= abs(I_obs))

# -------------------------------
# 7. Reporting
# -------------------------------
print(f"data_points_used = {N}")
verdict = "CLUSTERED" if (p_value < 0.05 and I_obs > 0) else "NOT CLUSTERED"
print(f"FINAL ANSWER: {verdict} (statistical method = Moran's I, p = {p_value})")
